capabilities: Hide timestamp prefixes in rendered internal links
Hide prefixes in workspace tab titles and Vertical Tabs
Hide prefixes in inline titles inside notes
Customize the prefix pattern with a regular expression
Toggle hiding on or off from settings
extras: The README explicitly lists what the plugin does not do (renaming files, modifying Markdown, altering link resolution, patching File Explorer, Search, Backlinks, Quick Switcher, or Graph View UI), and notes English and Simplified Chinese interface support with fallback to English.
problem: Zettelkasten vaults name notes with timestamp prefixes that clutter rendered link text and titles while Obsidian offers no way to hide them for display only.
summary: Display filter that hides timestamp prefixes in Zettelkasten-style internal links, tab titles, and inline titles without altering files.
